summary: Compare integrator tick freshness with the locally served build identity and invalidate installs for all workspace source inputs.

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild of application data.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes. Developer tick logs add servedSha and servedError diagnostics.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Developer-only scripts. Tick current now represents the served revision, not the filesystem build. Existing install-key filenames remain compatible and old keys invalidate once.

downtime.detail: No running service is activated by this change.

manual.detail: No released-product manual step. Deployment owners can adopt the updated tick observation logic.

recovery.detail: No persistent application state changes. Failed served-identity observations report current false.
